Fixed: createPlan validates periodId against PERIODS and falls back to the default. Covered in model.test.mjs.

Steps carry an ordered list of timed lines; scheduler moved from per-cook watermark to busy intervals so waiting time inside a step is usable. Proven in schedule.test.mjs: the same 17 min of work plans as 13 when broken down.

Implemented cook selection only: ties go to the cook already on that recipe, then to whoever has done least. Plan length provably unchanged (pinned at 30 min in schedule.test.mjs). The task-selection tolerance was deliberately not taken.
